title: Forge host configuration v1
description: One machine's capacity for runs the dispatcher admits (decision 0068 ruling 3 and ruling 5's data; the operator's ruling of 2026-10-10, option B). It belongs to the machine, never to a realm: one scratch disk, one set of provider accounts and its own local hardware, whichever realm a run operates. Brokkr reads it from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/brokkr/host.json, else $HOME/.config/brokkr/host.json. Every ceiling is a positive integer no greater than 4294967295: zero, a negative and an overflowing value are refused, never read as unlimited. Every object is closed. Cool-down bounds are not part of v1.

providers.description: Provider name, as an adapter's provider field names it (claude, codex, dsh, exec, ...), to its concurrency ceiling. A provider a queued run would seat that is not named here holds the run undeclared.

ceiling.description: The running runs that seat this provider, each counted once, below which another may start. A seat on a shared-local route of the provider is not counted here.

routes.description: Route name, the route a seat's driver serves the concrete model id the adapter maps on: the id's prefix before its first / (decision 0036 ruling 2), else the driver's default route (dsh serves a bare id on deepseek-official), to its ceiling and class. A route a queued run would seat that is not named here holds the run undeclared.

floor_bytes.description: The free bytes the seat scratch filesystem must hold for another run to start.

path.description: The absolute path whose filesystem is measured, where it is not the scratch default: the .forge/scratch directory of the repository the queued run operates, where its seats' scratch trees are made. A path not made yet is measured on the filesystem that would hold it.

ceiling.description: The running runs that build behind a boxed boundary (namespace, seatbelt or container) below which another boxed run may start.

class.description: cloud: behind a provider account, counted against this ceiling and the provider's. shared-local: on local hardware the machine shares with other work (decision 0068 ruling 5), counted against this ceiling in place of the provider's.
